info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Production Release Management API
info.description: The Production Release Management API provides endpoints to manage and track the deployment of production releases in banking IT systems. This API allows users to retrieve details about specific production release events, facilitating effective oversight and coordination among development and operations teams. Typical consumers include IT managers and DevOps professionals who need to monitor and ensure a smooth deployment process. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their release management practices and improve service reliability.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about the specific production release identified by the provided ID (PROD-700045). This operation allows developers to access key data related to the particular release, including status, deployment date, and associated changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the production release specified by the identifier PROD-700045. Please ensure that all required parameters are properly defined and follow the schema specifications.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the data is returned.

GetProductionReleaseDetailsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the production release operations in the IT management system.

residualValue.description: The residual value of the leased asset.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the release.
